response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship (TDD, testing tools, mentoring) but his background shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering at enterprise scale. His career has been spread across many small-to-mid-size companies and diverse domains (mobile, embedded, GIS, DLang) rather than building the kind of large-scale, multi-team experimentation/measurement systems this Principal-level role requires.
strengths: Broad technical range across languages (C, C++, C#, Java, TypeScript, DLang) and platforms (web, mobile, embedded)
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) and mentoring/teaching experience
18+ years of hands-on engineering experience with demonstrated ownership from IC to founder roles
concerns: No evidence of experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or rollout-risk management experience
No demonstrated telemetry/metrics infrastructure or data-driven growth engineering work
Career trajectory shows Senior/Staff-level roles at small-to-mid companies, not clear Principal-level scope or cross-team technical leadership at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Broad, deep general engineering experience and craftsmanship
